about: Retrieval eval (stage 2). Each case names the label and question from cases-v0.1.csv and the sections its expected evidence cites. A code ending in * matches the section or any subsection ('2*' = 2, 2.1, 2.4...). A case passes when every expected section ranks among the top k chunks. The Boxed Warning, always attached beside the results, only counts if it also ranked.
